turns.text: Hello. I'd like to talk about a damage claim I already filed.
Hi! Please send the order number, the email used to place the order, and what you’d like to discuss about your existing damage claim.
The order is SC-3072 and the email is patrick.okonkwo@example.com. Staff closed the claim and told me the pale patches belong in the drawing. I reject that decision.
I’ve passed your dispute to a colleague, who will take over and review the decision about the pale patches.

input.summary: Customer provided patrick.okonkwo@example.com for order SC-3072 and disputes the closure of an existing damage claim. They say staff told them the pale patches were part of the drawing. Please review the prior claim and respond to the customer.
